# The rule, in the order it is applied:
# 1. The extension is what follows the **last** dot in the file's own name.
#    No dot at all, a dotfile (`.gitignore`), a trailing dot (`file.`) and a
#    directory component holding a dot (`a.d/b`) all have no extension.
# 3. Anything not in this table is `application/octet-stream`: an unknown
#    extension must not stop the file being read.
# `text/plain` is the answer wherever a person is the reader. A previewed
